tools.name: screen_universe
tools.description: Screen the whole market on ONE completed interval with several conditions ANDed together. Pick bar (1d, the default, or 1h on a Pro key; a free key is screened at 1d). Conditions use op >, <, >=, <=, between, top_pct or bottom_pct; top_pct/bottom_pct are deciles of your eligible markets, and the liq

tools.name: live_market
tools.description: What is happening right now: mark price, current hourly funding, open interest (one-sided — counted once per contract, half of the both-sides figure Hyperliquid's own UI shows, so it is directly comparable with the oi_usd column the bar tools return), 24-hour traded notional and premium for up to 25

tools.name: get_universe
tools.description: The coverage picture: the last complete interval, how many markets are in the universe for a scope, how much history sits behind them, and how densely it is populated. Pick bar (1d, the default, or 1h on a Pro key) to describe completed days or completed hours. The range counts cover the last 7 days

tools.name: list_fields
tools.description: Every field the query tools accept, each with its meaning, unit, whether it can be missing, and which bars (1d, 1h) it exists on. Open — no key needed. Call this before query_cross_section, screen_universe or query_series. Percentile, z-score and the top_pct/bottom_pct conditions rank within the mar

tools.name: describe_dataset
tools.description: The full dictionary for ONE downloadable dataset: description plus every column's type, nullability and plain-English meaning. Pass a name from list_datasets. Open — no key needed. For the fields the query tools accept, use list_fields.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: List the downloadable datasets: one-line summary, the plan required, and the month range available. Open — no key needed. Then use describe_dataset for one dataset's columns, or list_fields for the fields the query tools accept.

tools.name: query_cross_section
tools.description: Rank the whole market on ONE completed interval: pick bar (1d, the default, or 1h on a Pro key), columns, an order_by field and top_n. Answers 'top markets by funding / open interest / returns on the latest day or hour' and 'what percentile is BTC on open interest'. day defaults to the last complete

tools.name: funding_divergence
tools.description: Rank markets by how far their funding has diverged from a benchmark (default ETH) over a trailing window. Pick bar (1d, the default, or 1h on a Pro key) to read completed days or completed hours. day defaults to the last complete interval. metric=rate compares mean funding over the window; metric=cu

tools.name: query_series
tools.description: The series for one market or a few (max 10): one row per market per interval over a trailing window, ordered by interval then market. Pick bar (1d, the default, for one row per day, or 1h on a Pro key for one row per completed hour). Answers 'is this move backed by real flow' and 'how has positionin
